attribution.note: Zitron states the financing figure and expressly owns the cost estimate.

semantics.note: The normalization preserves the financing figure, estimated cost floor, infrastructure scope, and Oracle exclusion. A retrospective numerical estimate does not itself express probabilistic confidence.

contract.note: Funding plus additional attributable infrastructure is a fair reading of the stated cost estimate. Distinguishing commitments from receipts and preventing double counting are reasonable; the undefined allocation and financing basis affect adjudication.

evidence.note: Timely company disclosure of one financing round's committed capital. It establishes neither cumulative comparable financing nor additional infrastructure costs.
The filing was available before the cutoff and reports Anthropic's capital raised through June 30. It is a company disclosure, not a combined financing reconciliation or infrastructure allocation.

reviews.rationale: The packet establishes neither a reconciled combined financing total nor attributable infrastructure costs without overlap. It also supplies no reliable upper bound contradicting the cost floor. Neither numerical component is settled.

attribution.note: Zitron asserts the depreciation amounts and comparison in his own commentary.

semantics.note: The normalization faithfully captures the quarterly aggregate and comparison with the quoted AI sales figure.

contract.note: Using comparable property depreciation for calendar Q1 is an ordinary reading. Treating Google as Alphabet and separating the numerical total from the threshold comparison are fair. Broader cash-flow adjustments are not equivalent depreciation measures.

evidence.note: The timely Alphabet filing contradicts the stated Google amount. The supplied comparable calculation gives approximately $28.3 billion, contradicting $33.44 billion while retaining the greater-than-$25-billion comparison.

The supplied aggregate calculation supports the threshold comparison. Amazon's underlying $12.834 billion property expense also contradicts its stated $18.94 billion amount. These company disclosures do not establish AI-only depreciation.

reviews.rationale: Comparable quarterly disclosures yield approximately $28.3 billion, so the stated $33.44 billion total is contradicted. The narrower comparison survives because $28.3 billion exceeds $25 billion. This does not verify the AI revenue estimate or establish that AI-specific depreciation exceeded it.
